fge_export_package.source: FGE Atelier Core Matrix — v1.3 Expanded Substrate

Artifact + Skill Integrity.reason: Strong. Skills treated as first-class artifacts with full Skill DNA.

Connection Density.reason: Explicitly wired to all six pillars and core cross-thread skills.

Synthesis Coherence.reason: Transformation and transport layers integrate cleanly.

Maintenance Completeness.reason: Standardized templates + richer logging fields added.

transport_layer.description: rpg-cross-thread-context + persistent shared storage. Handles bidirectional movement of the entire matrix state between threads. Live threads can read current state, execute skill work (signature extraction, synthesis, gospel locking, document structuring), and write updates back. Current reality: Functional in active threads. Requires invocation. Cross-account movement is manual but now extremely clean with this export package.

transformation_layer.description: The unified registry matrix + the four core skills acting on it. Raw input (visuals, ideas, character data, infographics) → IDENTITY-locked, scored, logged, canon-registered entries. Skills are treated as first-class original named artifacts with their own Skill DNA.

improvements: Added 8 standardized Maintenance Action Templates for the most common operations: new registration, score update, cross-thread sync, skill integration, artifact transport, IDENTITY drift correction, synthesis audit, canon gate review.
Each template includes required fields, actor, timestamp, score_delta formula, and direct links to affected matrix sections.
Added action_category and automation_potential fields to every log entry.
Created a lightweight delta calculator pattern for future agent-assisted logging.
Result: Faster, more consistent logging during high-velocity production. Lower cognitive load. Better audit trail.
Created FGE-MATRIX-EXPORT-v1.0 package specification: a single, versioned JSON bundle containing core matrix + Skill DNA + queued artifacts + transport manifest + re-initialization instructions.
Added transport_readiness flag on every entry (Ready / Needs_Review / Locked).
Included version pinning and dependency map so the entire system can be dropped into a new account with minimal friction.
Added a living Cross-Account Sync Checklist inside the matrix itself.
Result: Moving the full system (or any subset) to another account is now fast, repeatable, and low-error. Directly supports multi-account workflow and viral build pace.

Each includes: required fields, actor, timestamp, score_delta formula, direct links to affected matrix sections, action_category, automation_potential. Lightweight delta calculator pattern included for agent-assisted logging.
maintenance_action_templates.result: Faster, more consistent logging during high-velocity production. Lower cognitive load. Better audit trail. Production-grade substrate.

cross_account_sync_checklist: 1. Generate/verify FGE-MATRIX-EXPORT-v1.0 bundle with current authoritative state and all transport_readiness=Ready flags.
2. Confirm no IDENTITY drift via quick synthesis gate review (use synthesis_audit template).
3. Package JSON bundle + any linked media/assets referenced in core_matrix_registry.
4. Transfer to target account/thread via secure channel.
5. In target: Invoke rpg-cross-thread-context with import mode on the bundle.
6. Run transformation layer to re-score, re-lock, and re-register all entries.
7. Execute canon_gate_review template. Log delta. Update local matrix. Re-export incremental version if changes applied.
fge_export_package.reinitialization_instructions: 1. Place FGE-MATRIX-EXPORT-v1.0.json in target workspace. 2. Load via rpg-cross-thread-context skill (import directive). 3. Apply transformation_layer to all entries for IDENTITY lock + scoring. 4. Run maintenance template: canon_gate_review. 5. Set transport_readiness flags appropriately. 6. Log the import action using standardized new_registration or cross-thread_sync template. 7. The substrate is now live and compounding in the new environment. No rebuild required.
fge_export_package.next_compounding_note: This v1.3 expansion is now live in the shared matrix. Every future registration, sync, or synthesis will compound on top of these improvements. The two weakest areas (maintenance logging friction and cross-account movement friction) have been turned into documented, templated strengths. The system remains fully under Prime Mover direction while becoming noticeably faster and more resilient.
fge_export_package.translation_layer_note: All future exports and artifacts will follow simple naming convention: [ASSET]-[VERSION]-[TRANSLATION-LAYER]-[TIER]. New info-cards built to same detail but compressed/HD at tiered levels (low-information high-compile for quick share; high-information low-compile for deep canon work). Level determined by information density of source infographic/asset.
